Alex: Quick sync — from the inc-901 postmortem: can everyone who owns an action item confirm owner + firm due date? tagging owners I remember: @Maya @Sam @Tess. Need final list for PM/CS before EOD Friday. :eyes:
Maya: I own 'runbook updates' — will open PR and update runbook by 2025-01-09 EOD. I'll paste PR link here when it's up.
Sam: I can take 'failover automation test' (A2). Targeting 2025-01-10; can try to move earlier if needed. Will add test plan to the ticket.
Tess: Alert threshold tuning (A3) is on me. I can finish tuning + deploy by 2025-01-10 morning. Will run smoke on staging 1/8.
Alex: Thanks — rough consolidated snapshot:
```
- A1: runbook updates — owner: Maya — due: 2025-01-09
- A2: failover automation test — owner: Sam — due: 2025-01-10
- A3: alert threshold tuning — owner: Tess — due: 2025-01-10
- A4: canary rollback doc + checklist — owner: UNASSIGNED — due: 2025-01-08
``` 
Alex: A4 is blocking the canary gating. Who can own the canary rollback doc? We need a reviewer + a test owner. :point_up:
Eric: I can draft the rollback checklist today but need someone to own the actual canary test runs — @Sam? Also suggest we list exact SLO/latency thresholds in the doc.
Sam: I can run the canary tests but won't have cycles until 1/9. If Eric drafts, I can validate and run on 1/10.
Maya: I can review Eric's doc. If Eric posts a quick PR, I'll review before EOD.
IncidentBot: Checklist created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-901?actionChecklist (auto-generated)
Alex: OK final commitments — please update the Jira with the exact due date and a short acceptance checklist. I'll ping PM after EOD. Commitments:
- Maya: A1 — PR + runbook by 2025-01-09
- Sam: A2 + canary test runs — tests + plan by 2025-01-10
- Tess: A3 — tuning + staging smoke by 2025-01-10 morning
- Eric -> Draft A4 today; Maya reviews; Sam to run 1/10
If any date slips, reply here and we will reschedule the follow-up meeting. :white_check_mark:
Tess: noted. I'll also add the metric screenshots to the Jira.
Sam: Added test plan to the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-901?focusedCommentId=12345
Alex: thanks all — closing the loop from my side. I'll compile this thread into the postmortem doc later tonight.
